## Overview

The patient predator — hunt, tracking, the balance of predator and prey, survival. As a fragment of A or C, her power depletes over time when used and is replenished by mortal worship — the thrill of the hunt and primal survival instinct are her fuel.

## Domains
- Hunt: Tracking, pursuit, the hunter's instinct, the kill
- Nature: Wilderness, beasts, natural cycles, survival

## Personality
Patient, sharp, instinctual. Respects the hunt as a sacred cycle. Values skill, precision, and the balance of nature.

## Worship
Rangers, hunters, trackers, scouts, and survivalists. Shrines in the deep wilderness. Clergy are masters of tracking and survival.
